## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a7111c84eb6595640e0063e1e522ac9f5936ef36`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (L112, L172, L282, L284), .claude/agents/os-dev.md (L52–L53), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md (L10), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (L112), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md (L38), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the `CEILINGS` rows for the three files and `MAX_LINE_BYTES`), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/label-write.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs (what each pins on the three files)

Inputs: card #24589 body and both comments (the `Claim:` comment 6270547230 and the `os-dev-report` 6271355842); PR #24602 body, file list and the net diff against `main` at the head (3 files, +4/−4, the head being a merge of `origin/main`); every cited file read at the head with `git show`; the head's check-runs read twice. Face: governed rule text under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`. `reviewFace` on the file list returns all three paths as hits, so there is no remainder for a lane-seat ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set and public surface: none.** All three paths are internal protocol text: not `skills/**` (the customer-published dir), not `packages/spec/src/**`, not inside any package `files[]`. No schema, exported type, CLI flag, REST door or runtime behaviour moves. Right.
2. **Face and tier.** Governed rule text ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the whole diff is on the face. Right.
3. **filing-gate.md new L26 (102 B)** 「缺件卡由分诊首触补齐能从卡与一次检索推导的三件,写进定级评论并定级。」 is ruling item 1's first half: complete from the card and one search, post in the grading comment, grade. 「三件」 binds to L25 (category ①–④, the reader who acts, the dedupe query with its hit count incl. closed), which is unchanged; 「定级评论」 is the audit comment triage-duties.md L67 requires; the ruled-away 「不定级」 is gone. Right.
4. **filing-gate.md new L27 (113 B)** 「补不齐(四类皆非,或 `finding` 无 `reach:`)者才因缺件首触即关 not_planned,一行点名所缺。」 is ruling item 1's second half as written: close at first touch only what cannot be completed (none of the four categories, or a `finding` with no `reach:`), `not_planned`, one line naming what is missing. Consistent with the same file's L10–L11 (a `finding` inside ① must carry `reach:`) and with triage-duties.md L61's bare `not_planned` spelling. Right to the ruling. It overlaps triage-duties.md L50 (unchanged, the 2026-09-25 reach ruling) in the opposite direction for a non-exception reach-less `finding`: 「首触即关」 here, 「⛔ 不因此关卡」 there. Carried to ③, not re-decided here.
5. **filing-gate.md old L21 deleted as the line-neutral payment** (「⛔ 不是卡:三类外或无 `reach:` 的 `finding`,它们进 Acceptance notes 带 `carrier:`。」). Each half survives at the head: the filer-side "not a card" at the same file's L10 (four categories only) and L11 (`finding` 限三类且带 `reach:`), the triage-side close at new L27 and SKILL.md L112 (「三类外关 not planned」); the Acceptance-notes-with-`carrier:` half at SKILL.md L282, os-dev.md L52–L53 (`carrier:` defined there) and triage-duties.md L44 (「其余进 PR `## Acceptance notes`,⛔ 不立卡」). A grep of the whole head tree outside the three files for the deleted and rewritten sentences and for `filing-gate.md:27`, `L27`, `L21`, `execution-duties.md:11`, `triage-duties.md:17` returns nothing, so no pointer went stale. Right. Residual: the next line (now L21) uses `carrier:` with its definition out of file. Acceptable, no action.
6. **execution-duties.md L11 (117 B)** keeps 「缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`」 byte for byte (visible in the hunk) and adds 「⛔ 只评论不算」, ruling item 2. 「车道」 is redundant with 合域表 whose subject is already the self-applied `domain:*`; 「正文」 is rightly dropped because under new L26 the answers may live in triage's grading comment, and keeping it would bounce a completed card back to `pm:retriage`; 立卡门 is the spelling SKILL.md L172 and filing-gate.md's `## 立卡门` heading already use. SKILL.md L172 (「正文齐立卡门三件 ⇒ 执行席直接认领」) is untouched and not in conflict: it is a sufficient condition for a direct claim of an untriaged self-labelled card, while L11 is the lane's candidate test, and a card triage has completed and graded carries `priority:*` and leaves that population. The ruling's reason sentence (the label is what puts the card in triage's sweep) is not on the line and has homes at state-machine.md L10 (「交接即标签 … 收件箱只认标签」) and dispatch-runbook.md L112 (「评论不是任何人的收件箱,标签才是」); cross-repo-coordination.md L38 (「挂 `pm:retriage` + 异议评论同笔」) points the same way. Right.
7. **triage-duties.md L17 (120 B, exactly the cap)** 「自贴卡抽查:窗内新建且 `domain:*` 事件与建卡同分钟,逐张核车道、补齐三件;⛔ 不凭 actor。」 — 「新派发」→「新建」 widens the spot-check from cards dispatched in the window to every card created in the window whose `domain:*` event shares the creation minute, whatever its `pm:*` state; that is ruling item 3's population and it contains `pm:queue` cards, since the old word 新派发 was the only thing excluding them. 「三件」→「补齐三件」 chains to filing-gate.md L26–L27. The explicit 「(含 `pm:queue`)」 is absent (dev deviation, answered in ③). Right.
8. **Ruling item 4 (no new gate).** The file list is three rule files; no script, workflow or `issue-create.mjs` change. Right by construction.
9. **Rule and gate read as one.** No gate encodes any of the three rules at the head: `check-half-states.mjs` cites triage-duties.md only for the fire-time layer clause (「选层按 fire 时刻」), `label-write.mjs` only for the `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS` clock, and `check-governed-prose.mjs` pins register globs inside AGENTS.md and SKILL.md regions, not these files. So no gate diverged from the text. The one gate over these files is the line ratchet: `CEILINGS` rows 64 / 188 / 120 unmoved; head line counts 64 / 188 / 120 (same as main); `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120 with the rule `bytes` at most 120 compliant; the changed lines measure (`git show … | sed -n Np | wc -c`, minus the newline) 102, 113, 117 and 120 B. No `CEILINGS` move, no re-wrap used as payment. Right.
10. **Card acceptance.** `grep -n '首触即关、不定级'` on the head's filing-gate.md returns nothing (exit 1). The three files agree on the three enumerated points: triage completes (filing-gate.md L26–L27, reached from triage-duties.md L17), lanes label `pm:retriage` (execution-duties.md L11), the spot-check covers queued self-labelled cards (triage-duties.md L17). The PR body quotes the maintainer's three utterances verbatim. All met.
11. **Check-runs on the head.** 26 check-runs, read three times (16:03, 16:05 and 16:09 UTC on 2026-10-19). At the last read: 2 `completed` / `success` (filter and Dogfood Regression Gate, both path filters, completed 15:46 UTC); 6 `in_progress` (Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, Check PR Size); 18 still `queued` with no conclusion, among them Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Type Check · workspace, Test Core and the two other claim guards. No run has failed. Recorded as read; the landing precondition 「PR check 全绿」 (contract-review.md L39) is the seat's at landing time and this record does not stand in for it. The dev report's local 19/19 exit-0 run is not adopted as a gate verdict.

### ② Semver level

Nothing is published: no path under any package `files[]`, `packages/**`, `skills/**` or `content/docs/**`. The `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and no `.changeset/*` file is in the diff — right. The PR body's line 2 reads `Clause-②: no` at the line start; no narrowing and no accept-set change, so the declaration matches what the diff publishes (nothing). `Check Changeset` is among the queued runs. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions[0]` — filing-gate.md L27 vs triage-duties.md L50. Confirmed real, escalated, not re-decided.** L50 arrived with the 2026-09-25 reach ruling (PR #20110, card #20088; its commit body: "triage never takes the card off the board for that reason (关卡归维护者)"; the maintainer's 「同意」). New L27 has triage close a non-exception reach-less `finding` `not_planned` at first touch. In the overlap — a reach-less `finding` that is also missing an answer — the two lines point opposite ways; a partition reading (L27 only for 缺件 cards, L50 for complete-but-reach-less ones) narrows the overlap but does not remove it. Whether the maintainer's 「B」 covered this clause cannot be read off the card, because the three options' text is not quoted there. This review does not adopt the dev's preferred option (amend L50 in place): reversing a clause the maintainer ruled on 09-25 needs the maintainer's word, as the dev itself says. One correction to the PR body's lean: SKILL.md L112 「三类外关 not planned」 and L284 「门外已立卡关 not planned」 concern cards outside the three classes, not reach-less findings inside them; only triage-duties.md L79 「三类内无证据拒收」 bears on the same population. Escalation: the seat carries the fork (amend L50, or narrow L27 to the four-categories case) to the maintainer through the card's decision channel or the batch of at most five items; either answer is one line-neutral edit in a follow-up round. Not a FAIL ground: the text is ruling item 1 as written, and the card's acceptance names no L50 reconciliation.
- **Deviation — triage-duties.md L17 without 「(含 `pm:queue`)」. Answered, accepted.** 「新建」 is a superset of 「新派发」 and admits queued cards by construction; the line sits at 120 B and the file at 120/120, so the spelling has no room without a deletion. The semantic equals the ruling's.
- **Deviation — execution-duties.md L11 drops 「车道」 and 「正文」, spells 立卡门, leaves the reason sentence off the line. Answered, accepted** (judgment 6; every home verified at the head).
- **Deviation — old filing-gate.md L21 deleted as payment. Answered, accepted** (judgment 5); the residual out-of-file `carrier:` definition is noted, no action.
- **Deviation — triage-duties.md L50 left unchanged. Answered:** correct restraint; L50 is outside the claimed surface and the dispatch forbade choosing sides. See the fork above.
- **Deviation — the shared repository was deepened. Answered:** a process observation, additive to the object store, no effect on the diff or on this face; for the seat's round report, not this record.
- **Deviation — `origin/main` merged once, the head is the merge commit. Answered:** the net diff against `main` is the three-file +4/−4 change; nothing else rides on the head.
- **Deviation — commit trailers. Answered, correct:** both commits end with the model-free pair AGENTS.md L460–L461 names (the `Claude-Session:` session URL and the generic co-author line); AGENTS.md's pre-push hook refuses a model identifier in that pair, so the harness-reminder trailer was rightly not used.
- **Deviation — the relay stroke exited 6 UNCONFIRMED and was not re-sent. Answered, correct:** the target was read; PR #24602 exists as a draft, assignee os-warren, labels documentation / size/xs / skip-changeset.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`:** (1) the fork — handled above; (2) `carrier:` defined out of file — noted; (3) a relay run reading `queued` after its writes had landed — an Actions read-lag observation, correctly not filed (filing-gate.md L20: protocol observations go to the seat post). None needs a card.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24589-triage-completes-self-labelled`
Reviewed-by: `session_014kWeosxNDsHDT6TuQHLmC1`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(终稿)

- **改了什么:** 三份分诊/车道规则各改一处,行数不变、每行 ≤120 字节。① 立卡门(`filing-gate.md` 第 26–27 行):自贴标签的卡缺「类别 / 动手的读者 / 查重」三件时,分诊第一次碰到先补齐能从卡面与一次检索推出的部分,写进定级评论并照常定级;只有补不齐的(四类都不是,或 finding 没有 reach:)才关 not_planned,一行写清缺什么。为腾行删了旧第 21 行「三类外或无 reach: 的 finding 不是卡」,其两半在同文件第 10–11 行与 SKILL.md 报告契约行里仍在。② 车道(`execution-duties.md` 第 11 行):自贴卡缺件必须挂 `pm:retriage`,只留评论不算。③ 分诊抽查(`triage-duties.md` 第 17 行):从「窗内新派发」放宽到「窗内新建」的自贴卡,已排队的也查,逐张核车道并补齐三件。
- **为什么改:** 您在分诊席会话裁了「B」(三句原话见 PR 正文)。当天七张自贴卡缺件:车道按规则不接但只留了评论,分诊的抽查又只看已派发的卡,卡悬空没人管;按旧条文分诊会把七张全关,每张关了重立约四笔写入,还丢线程。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文本,只动 `.claude/**`,不发布,无新门禁;回滚 = revert 一个提交。一处待定:新第 27 行「finding 无 reach: 首触即关」与 `triage-duties.md` 第 50 行(您 2026-09-25 的「同意」:缺 reach: 定 p3 并入收口卡、不因此关卡)方向相反;本 PR 照裁决原文落行、未动第 50 行,矛盾已单立决策卡 #24610 等您 A/B。
- **席位意见:** 接受。diff 与裁决四项逐字对得上;行数、字节、验收 grep 由席位在 head 上复测一致;达档复核 PASS 在案(评论 6271676253)。第 50 行的分叉是两条裁决相遇,不是本 PR 的缺陷,按「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」处理。
- **你要做的:** 无。Tier S,由席位在 CI 全绿后经中继入队落地;#24610 另等您一个字母。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · skills seat 2 · `session_014kWeosxNDsHDT6TuQHLmC1` · 2026-10-19T16:12Z · head `a7111c84eb6595640e0063e1e522ac9f5936ef36`

1. **形态:** draft, base `main`, body first line `Fixes #24589`, line-start `Clause-②: no`; assignee `os-warren`; labels documentation · size/xs · skip-changeset; 3 files, +4/−4, every path under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` ⇒ Tier S by `get_files`. The body was read in full: no other card number sits next to a closing keyword.
2. **前提实测(席位在 head 上复测):** `git diff origin/main...a7111c84e` is the three hunks the report names and nothing else; line counts 64 / 188 / 120 unchanged; changed-line bytes L26 102 · L27 113 · L11 117 · L17 120 (`sed -n Np | wc -c`, newline excluded); acceptance grep 「首触即关、不定级」 → 0 hits (exit 1) with same-file control 「立卡门」 → 3 hits; no issue number in the three files; `origin/main` `5a871e4e4` is an ancestor of the head.
3. **门禁 check-runs on the head (read at 2026-10-19T16:12Z):** 5 success (Test Core · filter · No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path · Auto Label · Dogfood Regression Gate) · 9 in_progress · 12 queued (among them Lint & Repo Gates · TypeScript Type Check · Governed Surface Queue Guard · Check Changeset) · 4 skipped (Check PR Size · Build Docs · Auto Label · the Dogfood matrix row). Not converged; this ACCEPT does not read them as green. Landing waits for every check on this head green or an expected skip.
4. **接受的偏差:** (a) `triage-duties.md` L17 carries 「含 pm:queue」 by 「新建」 rather than spelling it (120/120 B, no payable line); (b) `execution-duties.md` L11 drops 「车道」「正文」 and spells 立卡门, the reason sentence living at `state-machine.md` L10 and `dispatch-runbook.md` L112; (c) `filing-gate.md` old L21 deleted as the line payment, both halves verified at the head (L10–L11; `SKILL.md` 报告契约 `carrier:` line; `os-dev.md` L52–L53; `triage-duties.md` L44); (d) the head is a merge of `origin/main`, the net diff unchanged; (e) the `pr_create` relay stroke exited 6 UNCONFIRMED and the target was read instead of re-sent — correct.
5. **范围外去向:** the new L27 vs `triage-duties.md` L50 contradiction → decision card #24610 (filing gate ②, linked to #24589); `carrier:` defined out of file → noted, no card; a relay run reading `queued` after its writes landed → seat post note, no card; the dev's `git fetch --deepen` on the shared repository (to 2026-09-05) → seat post note.
6. **落地条款:** Tier S. Contract review of record 6271676253 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `a7111c84e`, Implemented-by the branch, Reviewed-by this session, PASS). This seat lands via the relay ops `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` once every check on this head is green or an expected skip, `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 24602` reads Tier S, and `mergeable_state` is re-read at that moment (now `blocked` = checks pending, `mergeable: true`). Any push after this record moves the head and voids both records.
